title: "Null Island Site Selection Exercise"
description: "A GIS site-selection exercise set on a fictional island, free to download and use in your own teaching."
draft: true
---

Null Island sits at 0° latitude, 0° longitude, where in reality there is only open ocean. Here it has a small island, a few species of concern, and a conservation association that needs help choosing a site.

## The assignment

Students get the map layers and a short profile of each species. They work out the site-selection analysis on their own, then write it up as an issue of the **Null Island Conservation Association Newsletter**: a piece for a general reader that explains the problem, shows maps of each step, and works in facts about the animals. The write-up explains what was done and why, not which buttons were pushed.

::: {.callout-note}
The island, the species and the data are all made up, so the results can be shared openly without being mistaken for a real proposal.
:::
